title: QR code for a short URL
goals: Let people share a scannable code for any short link
functionalRequirements: GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/qr returns a QR code that encodes the short URL
size is the image edge in pixels: default 256, between 64 and 1024
nonFunctionalRequirements: The code is generated in-process, with no network calls
The same input always produces the same image
Unknown, deleted and expired codes behave like the redirect (404 / 410)
acceptanceCriteria: A PNG response decodes back to the short URL and has the requested size
An SVG response is well-formed and scales to the requested size
Sizes outside 64-1024 and unknown formats are rejected with 400
An unknown code returns 404 and a deleted code returns 410
assumptions: The QR code encodes the short URL, not the original URL
Error correction level M is sufficient
